notes: Scores by learning goal, if you want them. Keep your own list of goals (a skill, or a standard from your school) in Settings, Grading, or add one wherever you tag.
Tag rubric rows in Rubric setup and quiz questions in Quiz boxes. An assignment scored with just a total can carry one goal for the whole score.

Each class page gets a Goals tab: the class average on each goal with the lowest first, every student by every goal, and where each number came from. A student's own page shows their goals beside the class average.
Nothing changes until you add a first goal, and tagging never changes a score or a grade.
